comment: * Fluent API to build RFC * 2387-compliant request bodies. * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

variables.name: MIXED
variables.comment:
* The "mixed" subtype of "multipart" is intended for use when the body
   * parts are independent and need to be bundled in a particular order. Any
   * "multipart" subtypes that an implementation does not recognize must be
   * treated as being of subtype "mixed".

variables.name: ALTERNATIVE
variables.comment:
* The "multipart/alternative" type is syntactically identical to
   * "multipart/mixed", but the semantics are different. In particular, each
   * of the body parts is an "alternative" version of the same information.

variables.name: DIGEST
variables.comment:
* This type is syntactically identical to "multipart/mixed", but the
   * semantics are different. In particular, in a digest, the default {@code
   * Content-Type} value for a body part is changed from "text/plain" to
   * "message/rfc822".

variables.name: PARALLEL
variables.comment:
* This type is syntactically identical to "multipart/mixed", but the
   * semantics are different. In particular, in a parallel entity, the order
   * of body parts is not significant.

variables.name: FORM
variables.comment:
* The media-type multipart/form-data follows the rules of all multipart
   * MIME data streams as outlined in RFC 2046. In forms, there are a series
   * of fields to be supplied by the user who fills out the form. Each field
   * has a name. Within a given form, the names are unique.

variables.name: partHeaders
variables.comment: Parallel lists of nullable headers and non-null bodies.

methods.name: public MultipartBuilder type(MediaType type)
methods.comment:
* Set the MIME type. Expected values for {@code type} are {@link #MIXED} (the
   * default), {@link #ALTERNATIVE}, {@link #DIGEST}, {@link #PARALLEL} and
   * {@link #FORM}.

methods.name: public MultipartBuilder addPart(RequestBody body)
methods.comment: Add a part to the body.

methods.name: public MultipartBuilder addPart(Headers headers, RequestBody body)
methods.comment: Add a part to the body.

methods.name: private static StringBuilder appendQuotedString(StringBuilder target, String key)
methods.comment:
* Appends a quoted-string to a StringBuilder. * *

RFC 2388 is rather vague about how one should escape special characters * in form-data parameters, and as it turns out Firefox and Chrome actually * do rather different things, and both say in their comments that they're * not really sure what the right approach is. We go with Chrome's behavior * (which also experimentally seems to match what IE does), but if you * actually want to have a good chance of things working, please avoid * double-quotes, newlines, percent signs, and the like in your field names.

methods.comment: Add a form data part to the body.

methods.comment: Add a form data part to the body.

methods.comment: Assemble the specified parts into a request body.
